raw_html: [[Banishing Weapons]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Banishing Weapons]]:''' While wearing this item, your melee and ranged weapons gain Vorpal Effect: In addition, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this weapon will banish a creature from this plan of existence. Powerful creatures may resist the vorpal effect until sufficiently wounded.
